title: Ashleigh Moran
seoTitle: Ashleigh Moran - Accredited Specialist Family Lawyer Sydney
description: Ashleigh is an Accredited Specialist in Family Law. As a family lawyer she takes a pragmatic yet compassionate approach to resolving matters.
jobTitle: Senior Associate - Accredited Family Law Specialist
html:
Ashleigh has dedicated her career as a lawyer to family law having worked in various separate family law specialist practices in Sydney prior to her appointment as a Senior Associate at Nolan Lawyers. Ashleigh provides advice on all areas in family law including parenting disputes, property matters including complex financial structures, child support, spouse maintenance and divorce.

Ashleigh prides herself on being compassionate and empathetic toward clients during a difficult time in their lives. She is particularly motivated by a wish to resolve disputes without resorting to litigation where possible. Ashleigh has successfully represented clients at mediations in relation to both parenting and property matters.

Ashleigh is also confident in appearing on behalf of her clients in the Federal Circuit and Family Court of Australia.

Ashleigh is a member of:

  • Law society of NSW
  • Family Law Section

Her qualifications are:

  • Bachelor of Laws & Bachelor of Business and Commerce (Accounting)
  • Admitted as a lawyer to the Supreme Court of NSW
  • Admitted as a lawyer to the High Court of Australia
